notes.title: Casina just released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Just wanted to let you know about our newest game!
We have been working on it for a very long time, it's a fully animated and fully voiced Visual Novel!

It's inspired by an awesome comedy from Ancient Greece, go check it out! 

features:

- Different endings (Good and Bad) + secondary dialogue choices.
- Fully Animated and professionally Voice Acted, complete with a unique character lip-syncing system.
- Multiple different Character Dynamic Expressions!
- 30+ CGS featuring Neoclassic Game's artworks.
- Full OST provided by the ever talented Vindsvept Fantasy Music.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1215740/Casina_A_Visual_Novel_set_in_Ancient_Greece/

notes.title: Workshop Update & Upcoming news
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
We are back with another update! During the past few months we have been working on our workshop and we are happy to announce that mod support will become one of our primary goals.

Workshop Upgrade and Events:
- First of all, a big patch for the game that will add some new features. Community feedback has been really useful so far, keep it coming!

- We plan to add extra levels via our Workshop every month!

- Monthly competitions such as mod of the month with special rewards.
We are really looking forward on making our art library even bigger, giving you a wide choice of new levels to complete.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/730b29a9bd5c4d00867d34b85180c79894c93203.jpg

DLC retiring from the Shop
We are going to remove the following DLC from the Steam Store:
- Anime Artist - KeikoKup Expansion Pack 
- Anime Artist - Rosuuri's Pack 
- Anime Artist - Fleesveon's Art

Unfortunately those Dlcs have not been successful at all and keeping supporting them has a cost.
So we decided to remove them from the store right away. This will not affect gameplay at all and, if you already purchased any of them, they will stay in your library.

notes.title: Introducing Anime Artist 3
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!
We are supper happy to announce our newest and best title Anime Artist 3!
We have been working on this game for quite a long time and we payed really close attention to your feedback, trying to offer you the ultimate Anime Artist package!

It's indeed without any doubt the most feature packed both concerning the puzzle part of the game and the character customization.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1458590/Anime_Artist_3_Harem/

Here what's new and what have been improved.


- 4 Fully animated and Voiced lovely girls.
- Up to 20 artworks crafted by our artist Bicio (winner of the "2015 Latin American Manga contest).
- Our game also offers 40+ dresses and hair styles combined!
- An improved gallery to collect each artwork you unlcok
- And of course a 18+ patch with our special "rubber" tool!

We also decided to make a little contest.
Help us spread the word about the game, tell your friends to add it to their wishlist.
Thanks a lot for the support so far! We will keep doing our best to make Anime Artist even better in the future!

notes.title: Mac, Linux support + Anime Artist 2 available!
notes.content:
We have some very good news for you!

Since it's release we have been constantly working on updates, introducing new features such as the workshop, new brush tool, limited amount of color and so on. We are really looking forward to share with you what's upcoming:

Mac and Linux support.
Yeah! Progress is going smooth, we expect to release a Mac/Linux  version of the game during the month of March.

Workshop updates
We are planning to expand our workshop capabilities, making it more simple to create mods for the game. Also we plan to add new art (as mods) on a consistent pace.

Anime Artist 2!
This is the most exciting part of this update. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/4570e374d42593b08d9a0cf3eaa2b2a3f0e439fb.gif
The game tells the story of Danya, she wants to become an artist so the purpose of the game is to help her out!

Danya is fully animated and voiced + we have developed an interesting wardrobe system. You will be able to unlock new dresses and hairstyles. 
Customize Danya's appearance!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/8d86a02b238760290de8d3be734cc233aef51ada.gif

Feel free to check out the game, we can assure you it will be a blast!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221800/Anime_Artist_2_Lovely_Danya/

notes.title: Our Biggest Update!
notes.content:
We are finally back with another update! This is quite a big one that improves different aspects of the game. We will do our best to include every detail!

Improved Color Brush!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/47cf3e96102b8e278b8d6926b51db9be485197b1.png

A feature requested by many is now available.
Spamming colors everywhere will not work! Well it works but your Color Bar will drop to 0% very fast. This means you will probably get a "Game Over" screen.
It's important to choose your colors carefully and remember what you are drawing!

Bigger and smaller Brush sizes.
Want to be more precise while coloring or want to do it faster?
Use the scroll wheel of your mouse in order to choose the perfect size of your brush.

Free 18+ DLC finally available.
Well this is pretty much self explanatory!
(technically we published it a couple of weeks ago but it was never featured in a patch note)

More spicy content.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/198e72c00c59c50b5670b2dd5bb43bb28df9d1dc.jpg
For those who have installed the 18+ DLC, we have 4 additional hot images. We think you will be happy to have them in your collection!
- The levels Chidori 4, Howp 4, Trisha 4, Maya 4 now feature "Hot mode"! Feel free to erase what's "not necessary" from them.

New art!
The amazing artist Keikokup has decided to add new content to her DLC.
This means 2 extra levels for you at no additional cost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/2bfcbf2b2a865aa26cd58fdc9bbc3fa39d233419.jpg



Well that's all for now.
If you want, let us know what do you think with a comment or a review. Your feedback is really important to us!

notes.title: Patch 5 is here!
notes.content:
We are finally back with another update for our game. This is quite a big one that improves different aspects of the game. We will do our best to include every detail!

New level available for free.
Say hello to Maya again! Her newest artwork is now available to be drawn, colored and collected!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/198e72c00c59c50b5670b2dd5bb43bb28df9d1dc.jpg


A better Art Gallery
As suggested by many, our Art gallery now features the core game's DLCs as well.  This means
- Elisa the Innkeeper pack
- Ultra lewd Pack

Concerning the DLCs from indipendent artists we will add them as well in the future.

New Workshop features
This was also suggested by a player. 
- Mods now can feature the "Rubber Tool"!
- We also improved the "Steam workshop" listing and corrected a bug that prevented the latest mod to be played if all the previous ones weren't completed.

What about the next Update?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/f3665e410671a10616e55396bb3446acceb1c649.jpg
- We will keep adding new content to the game on a regular basis, however new art will now be added via the Workshop.
This will save us a lot of time since we'll not have to submit a new build through Steamworks.

- We are also working on the implementation of public worldwide Leaderboards for the game:
- Best time, Best average score, Most mod created/played and so on...
Want to be the best Anime Artist there is? You will be able to prove it to everyone very soon.

Contest Winners!
We know, we are late. Sorry!
Anyway congratulations to our winners! Many players submitted their mods and we are very happy with the result.
- 1st place Revius9001 
- 2nd place KristyCallahan
- 3rd place [Chris]

Concerning the special prize? For now no one managed to surpass our "Alice kiss" mod!

---

If you won, add us as a friend and we will arrange via chat a delivery method of your prize.

This contest was a very nice experience, we would like to organize another one in the future, probabliy when our Mods total count surpasses 50!

Well that's all for now, keep sending us feedback and, if you can, share the love with your friends!

notes.title: Workshop + Prizes
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that our game finally features mod support.
As we promised you are now able to upload your own artworks and challenge your friends to draw and color them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222197/730b29a9bd5c4d00867d34b85180c79894c93203.jpg

Time to celebrate! 
We decided to reward the best mods submitted during the month of September with real prizes!


1st - 200$ as steam gift cards
2nd -  6 copies of the game and your name in the game credits
3rd - 2 copies of the game and an artwork signed by our artist
+  "special" 50$ to the author of the mod with the most "Add to Favorites"



How to participate?

 Submit as many mods you want, our team will review each one of them and select the winner by the end of the month.
 Share this update with your friends, prizes will be awarded only if we reach a minimum amount of participants.


Other patch notes:


 Quality of life improvements, better management of stats
 Implemented a progressive method of unlocking artworks
 We've got a new gallery!
  2 New artworks! (1 available in the game and 1 downloadable as a mod)



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35222197/7cde7588b0e0cb32934649b3f416e0fbf016c8e5.jpg

Thank you so much for all the support, this has been an incredible month.
Feel free to share the love with a review or with a comment here, we are really happy to get some feedback.

Until the next update!
Neoclassic Games

notes.title: News, Trading Cards & Mod Support info here!
notes.content:
Hello everybody.
We are really glad to bring you Anime Artist, after so much development time. having the chance to get some feedback from you guys is pretty much awesome.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35222197/15e8b1467b720d9f6549fe03fac69144a2d8d250.jpg

Anyway enough with this.

Mod Support/Steam Workshop
Unfortunately we couldn't include this feature right away. Anyway it's coming ASAP. Having the chance to add new art to our game, draw your favourite anime characters and share them with your friends has been one of our main objective from the beginning.

Also infinite gameplay right? Always new fresh content.

New periodic free content
Rest assured that we won't be resting on what we did so far. New content ecc.

How long until a new update?
Just open the game and check the countdown in our main menu!


Steam Trading Cards
Cards will be available as soon Steam allows them. Feel free to give us a hand by sharing our game to your friends!

New upcoming features
- Hard and Master difficulty modes
- Art gallery
- New achievements.

Feel free to tell us what you think of Anime Artist!
